{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Protection]] which grants temporary damage reduction or [[Shield Stack]] which grants temporary immunity to damage and certain statuses.}}
{{Status infobox
|Shield
|The Shield can absorb damage while it is active. Some Shields may only absorb certain type(s) of DMG.
|type = Buff
|source = Operator
}}

[[Shield]] is a type of buff applied to operators in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator in the team casts a Combat Skill that grants Shield, any incoming damage that would otherwise reduce the operator's health reduces the operator's Shield instead for a set duration. If the Shield is reduced to zero, any effects that are granted while the Shield is active such as {{Icon|Ember icon|[[Ember]]'s}} {{Icon|Potential 5|{{Color|The Steel Oath|7}}}} is removed.
{{Clr}}
